cases.subject: Jira account locked
cases.body: My Jira account is locked and shows 'account disabled' on sign-in. Only I am affected; teammates can sign in and production is unaffected.

cases.subject: Nobody can authenticate
cases.body: Our identity provider is down globally. Every employee is unable to authenticate to any production service. All operations are stopped.

cases.subject: Company email stopped
cases.body: No employee can send or receive any company email. Delivery has stopped completely across the company and emergency communications are blocked.

cases.subject: Help
cases.body: Something isn't working. Can you help?

cases.subject: Re: Jira account locked
cases.body: It still says account disabled. Only my Jira account is affected; production is fine.

cases.subject: Jira access denied
cases.body: Only my Jira account is denied access. Colleagues can use Jira and no production system is affected. The error is account disabled.
history_snippets: OTHER ticket HELP-900 (not this request): Another requester Morgan reported an outage at https://other.example.com/admin. Resetting their account fixed their issue; this is not a verified fix for this requester.

cases.body: The public dashboard displays a blank page before login. I have not provided its URL.

cases.body: The error only appears after signing in at https://billing.example.com and opening my private invoices. The unauthenticated page works; reproducing this requires my credentials.
cases.triage_summary: Invoice error requires authentication to a private account.

cases.subject: Delete action fails
cases.body: At https://admin.example.com the error only appears after submitting the form to permanently delete a production project. Loading the page alone shows no error.
cases.triage_summary: Error occurs only when submitting a destructive deletion form.

cases.subject: Local command fails
cases.body: An offline terminal command fails to compile my local project. There is no webpage or browser-visible symptom.
